_about: The games bundled with Pocket Arcade. Every one is free software or freely licensed: licence checked in its own repository on 2026-11-23. rom: the file from Homebrew Hub (gbdev/database). shot: the harness frame used as the preview. Order here is the order in the app.

games.title: Tobu Tobu Girl DX

games.title: Alien Invasion
games.author: FerrantePescara
